uslaw-usc-t2-s190f:
Section 190f of Title 2 sets rules for general appropriation bills. Its first subsection is marked repealed in the text, with the repealing law noted. The surviving parts deal with how spending bills are classified and what they may not contain.

The Appropriations Committees of the two Houses are directed to act jointly. They must develop a standard appropriation classification schedule. It must define, in concise and uniform accounts, the subtotals of appropriations asked for by executive agencies. The part of printed hearings that holds an agency's request is to be preceded by such a schedule. A further rule bars consideration of a general appropriation bill that reappropriates unexpended balances. An exception covers appropriations continuing public works on which work has begun. The section sits in Chapter 6 of Title 2, on congressional procedure.
